public_url.description: Public HTTPS URL clients reach the server at. No path, no port unless non-standard.

name.description: Owner's name. Substituted as <name> in agent.soul.
Agent's name. Substituted as <agent.name> in agent.soul.

soul.description: SOUL.md template. <a.b> tokens are substituted from the config tree.

instructions.description: Optional operator-authored section appended to AGENTS.md beneath the auto-generated platform section. <a.b> tokens supported. Stays on the operator's local config.yaml — never check in.

skills.description: Names of Hermes skills to install at boot via `hermes skills install <name>`. Default [] = clean ship (no bundled skills). Add names to opt in; remove from list does NOT uninstall — call `hermes skills uninstall` for that. Custom skills can also be dropped directly into $HERMES_HOME/skills/<name>/ without going through this list.

commands.description: Slash-command autocomplete shown to users in Telegram. Default [] = no autocomplete clutter. Operator opts in.

github.description: Optional GitHub auth so private repo clones work — e.g. operator's personal skills repo. If token is set, git is configured to use it as a credential helper.

token.description: Personal access token (https://github.com/settings/tokens). Needs 'repo' scope for private repo access. Stays in your local config.yaml — never check in.

brave.description: Optional Brave Search API key — enables the Brave web-search backend for the agent. Omit (or leave api_key null) to fall back to the keyless ddgs backend.

api_key.description: Brave Search API key (https://brave.com/search/api/). The free tier works. Wired into Hermes as BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY. Stays in your local config.yaml — never check in.

gcalcli.description: Optional Google Calendar access via the `gcalcli` CLI. Omit / null to disable (agent gets no calendar access). When set, the agent can read + write calendars listed in `calendars`. Auth is one-time interactive: `everstone auth gcal`.

client_id.description: OAuth Client ID from Google Cloud Console → Credentials → OAuth Client ID (Desktop app). Looks like '12345-xxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com'. Not secret on its own but combined with client_secret it authenticates the app to Google.

client_secret.description: OAuth Client secret from the same Credentials → OAuth Client ID page. Looks like 'GOCSPX-xxxxxxxxxx'. Stays in your local config.yaml — never check in.

calendars.description: Scope-limiting policy: the agent self-respects these lists via AGENTS.md. Any calendar not in either list is off-limits. Use `primary` for the account's primary calendar; otherwise the calendar's email address. If omitted or both lists empty, the agent gets no Calendar section in AGENTS.md (auth works, but the agent doesn't know any calendars exist). Use `everstone calendar list` after auth to discover IDs to put here.

read_only.description: Calendars the agent can read but never modify (look at, suggest from, but no add/edit/delete).

read_write.description: Calendars the agent can freely add to, edit, and delete events from.

timezone.description: Operator home IANA timezone for es cal (e.g. America/Chicago). Per-call --tz overrides.
